preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)
Attacker must hold some TeaToken balance to demonstrate the fee impact

exploit_hint: As owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() with extremely high values (e.g., 99 each). Then perform token transfers to collect excessive fees into the contract address. The contract will accumulate fees and eventually swap them for ETH via swapAndLiquify, with liquidity added to the owner. Alternatively, set fees to 100 to make transfers impossible, disrupting the token's functionality.
